split_policy: Strict identity-disjoint split by pet_code (calibration vs acceptance_holdout). 56 pet identities are enrolled in the benchmark shop catalog; 12 pet identities (6 calibration, 6 acceptance_holdout) are held out as genuine absent-from-DB queries.
integrity_notes: Procedural resize/JPEG/crop variants measure exact and near-duplicate file invariance ONLY, NEVER multi-view recognition of the same real animal.
Same-pet different-photograph re-identification is marked NOT_EVALUATED because the repository contains at most 1 image per synthetic pet record.
No customer photos or external network/API calls are used.
